sampling: 32 samples for opaque goods; 64 for glass/gems; adaptive threshold 0.05 and denoising
material_delivery: Procedural PBR in editable natives; scalar/base-colour GLB fallback, not baked textures

visual_review.review_method: Inspect actual source-bound studio PNGs at full resolution and catalogue contact sheets; compare first-pass and refined versions
observations: All 101 current selected PNGs inspected in before/after comparison sheets; representative metal, glass, cloth, leather, cheese, cup and gem images also inspected at full or calibration resolution. Each accepted final image is bound to its native and raw-render hash.
Glass/crystal and gem transmission, absorption and facet reflections inspected; pearl contents are visible through TI045. Gem colours remain influenced by mounts and studio reflections.

Metals retain differentiated reflection and machining variation; cloth has role-specific sheen/weave, leather pore relief, wood grain, paper and restrained organic subsurface variation. Fine relief is subtler in gallery thumbnails than full PNGs.
TI041 rebuilt coat and rounded footwear reviewed in final 1024×768 image; continuous shells, closed shoulder caps, lapels, seams, soles and separate belt replace the angular first pass.
TI048 repaired cut-face reviewed at full resolution: dark slit removed; actual cavities retained; raw wheel mesh has zero nonmanifold edges.
TI067 repaired cup reviewed at full resolution: unintended rim cap removed, hollow reflective enamel interior visible and handles outside the bowl.
TI088–TI100 reviewed with final lower-exposure studio preset; coated, metal, ceramic/carbon components and inherited part details remain distinguishable.

Medical/fictional packaging, bulk goods/ores, artefacts, jewellery and TI101 paper/leather assembly reviewed without foreground clipping. First-pass assemblies are retained except documented targeted revisions.
TI064 remodelled final 1024×768 render inspected: solid crescent blades, cutting bevels, head socket/pins, turned wooden haft and restrained lunar inlays replace the primitive first pass.

TI064 ceremonial craft revision inspected at full resolution: recessed lunar/border channels, restrained patina, shallow forged-face relief and carved wooden grip. Lunar ornament is an authored interpretation of the Cyreni lore.
limitations: First-pass model topology and inferred details remain; this is a material/surface refinement rather than a complete remodelling pass.
